about_the_game:
TerrApocalipse

is a space game placed in our solar system, which was attacked by a powerful enemy. Soon the vast void between planets will be filled with conflict, the outcome of which will be determined by your actions.

Develop your profile in RPG style, you have several paths to choose from, it's up to you which one you follow or whether you create a unique solution that suits your playing style.

Strength

Win by choosing a path of strength and creating spaceships capable of single-handedly opposing countless enemy units.

Wisdom

Will allow you to develop futuristic technologies that will give you an advantage over your opponent and surprise his units.

Leadership

Create an armada that can defeat the most numerous opponents thanks to cooperation skills and good training.

Research and gather resources

Remember that progress is never quick or easy. Collect resources from asteroids and battles, every resource have value and any loss can give your opponent an advantage you won't be able to overcome.

Build and produce

Build space stations orbiting planets and moons, spaceships, equipment and weapons, enemy won't wait until you're ready, he will exploit every mistake you make.

Keep going

However, failure is never final and you can always start again, stronger and wiser thanks to experience and knowledge you have gained.

Good luck... you'll need it.
